verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single-file local LLM runtime that offers a CLI, a chat Web UI and an HTTP server. A buyer could fairly ask an AI tool about automation, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes defining rules or triggers that fire actions automatically on events. The documented server sandbox also blocks outbound connections, which points away from built-in event-driven actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
